dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O'-shaped structures in the mid-dorsal region exhibit sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior backgrounds to high-intensity white perimeters with darker interior centers. These clusters lack internal gradients and are distributed as isolated, asymmetrical points across the darker fur.
